title: Quantum holography: each Planck pixel of area holds one qubit

statements.text: In the quantum version of the holographic principle, a surface punctured in $N$ points by spin network edges carrying the spin one half representation of $SU(2)$ holds an $N$-qubit state, so each pixel of Planck area encodes a qubit rather than a bit.

sources.quote: N-qubit states are associated with surfaces that are punctured in N points by spin networks’ edges
